units.source_text: 第二天，我于同一时间来到海边，又遇见了先生。

en.t: The next day, I went to the beach at the same time and met Sensei again.
The third day was the same as well.

units.source_text: 但是，我没有找到跟先生搭话的机会，也没有相互问候。

en.t: However, I found no chance to speak to Sensei, and we did not even exchange greetings.

units.source_text: 而且看先生的做派，似乎不喜欢交际，

en.t: Moreover, from Sensei's manner, he seemed not to care for socializing,

units.source_text: 他总是定时定点，颇有规律地超然来去，

en.t: he always came and went at the same time and place, quite regularly and with detached composure,

units.source_text: 无论周遭多么热闹，似乎也丝毫引不起他的兴趣。

en.t: and no matter how lively his surroundings were, they seemed unable to arouse the slightest interest in him.

units.source_text: 最初同他一起来的那个外国人，后来再没有看见，

en.t: The foreigner who had come with him at first was never seen again afterward,

units.source_text: 有一次，先生照例迈着大步从海里上来，

en.t: One time, Sensei came striding up from the sea as usual,

units.source_text: 拎起脱在老地方的浴衣正要穿上，

en.t: and was just about to pick up and put on the yukata he had taken off in his usual place,

units.source_text: 不知怎么搞的，浴衣上沾满了沙子。

en.t: when, somehow, the yukata was covered with sand.

units.source_text: 为把沙子抖掉，先生背过身去抖了两三下浴衣。

en.t: To shake off the sand, Sensei turned his back and shook the yukata two or three times.

units.source_text: 这时，放在衣物下面的眼镜从板凳缝里掉了下去。

en.t: At that moment, the glasses placed beneath his clothes fell down through a gap in the bench.

units.source_text: 先生系好白底蓝花浴衣的宽腰带后，

en.t: After Sensei fastened the wide sash over his white yukata with blue patterns,

units.source_text: 像是发现眼镜丢了，便急忙在附近寻找起来。

en.t: he seemed to notice that his glasses were missing and hurriedly began searching nearby.

units.source_text: 我赶紧钻进凳子底下，拾起眼镜，

en.t: I quickly crawled under the bench and picked up the glasses,

units.source_text: 先生说了声“谢谢”，从我手里接过眼镜。

en.t: and Sensei said, "Thank you," and took them from my hand.
